SP Leader Accused of Religious Conversion, Denies Leaving Hinduism

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leaders accused Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Rajkumar Bhati of converting religions. Bhati, however, appeared publicly to deny these allegations, stating he had taken an oath not to worship Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh but denied renouncing Hinduism. The specific details of the oath and the context of the allegations were not further elaborated in the provided coverage.
